command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# PATH export IS needed: aarchbio images have their PATH dropped by the task shell.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
NREC=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="input_records"{print $2}' expected.tsv)
printf 'input_records\t%s\n' "$NREC"

pairtools --version 2>&1 | head -2

echo "== pairtools dedup: the valid-pair count this pipeline must conserve =="
# dedup is where the denominator for the whole recipe comes from. Whatever pairtools declares
# valid is what cooler must load -- the number is not hardcoded anywhere, it is produced here
# and carried forward, so the identity cannot be satisfied by agreeing with a constant.
pairtools dedup --mark-dups \
  --output dedup.pairs.gz \
  --output-stats dedup.stats \
  aag2.sample1.pairs > dedup.log 2>&1
RC=$?
printf 'dedup_rc\t%s\n' "$RC"
test "$RC" = "0" || { tail -25 dedup.log; echo "FAIL: pairtools dedup exited $RC"; exit 1; }

TOTAL=$(awk '$1=="total"{print $2; exit}' dedup.stats)
NODUP=$(awk '$1=="total_nodups"{print $2; exit}' dedup.stats)
DUPS=$(awk '$1=="total_dups"{print $2; exit}' dedup.stats)
printf 'pairtools_total\t%s\n' "$TOTAL"
printf 'pairtools_total_dups\t%s\n' "$DUPS"
printf 'pairtools_total_nodups\t%s\n' "$NODUP"

# pairtools' own bookkeeping identity: every input pair is either a duplicate or not.
test -n "$TOTAL" -a -n "$NODUP" -a -n "$DUPS" || { cat dedup.stats | head -20; echo "FAIL: could not read dedup stats"; exit 1; }
awk -v t="$TOTAL" -v n="$NODUP" -v d="$DUPS" 'BEGIN{ if (t+0 != n+0 + d+0) { printf "FAIL: total %d != nodups %d + dups %d\n", t, n, d; exit 1 } }' || exit 1
printf 'identity_dedup\ttotal == nodups + dups (%s == %s + %s)\n' "$TOTAL" "$NODUP" "$DUPS"
test "$TOTAL" = "$NREC" || { echo "FAIL: pairtools saw $TOTAL pairs, the staged file has $NREC"; exit 1; }
printf 'identity_input\tpairtools read every staged record\n'

# The deduped pairs still carry the format header the next task needs.
zcat dedup.pairs.gz | grep '^#columns:' | head -1 | sed 's/^/  /'

# Carried forward so the cooler task asserts against a number this run produced.
printf 'valid_pairs\t%s\n' "$NODUP" > denominator.tsv
{ printf 'observable\tvalue\n'
  printf 'pairtools_total\t%s\n' "$TOTAL"
  printf 'pairtools_total_dups\t%s\n' "$DUPS"
  printf 'pairtools_total_nodups\t%s\n' "$NODUP"; } > dedup_score.tsv
echo "PAIRTOOLS OK"
